retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album layout featuring a central beach photograph framed by heavy, stacked sans-serif typography in vibrant primary colors.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered composition consisting of a top header with bright pink text, a thin black horizontal bar with small orange text, and a large blue title overlaying a sunny beach scene with a vintage car and people.
coreVisualRelationships: Integration of text over a photographic horizon line
Subject-to-background depth with a vintage vehicle anchor
coreInvariants: Daylight beach setting with high-key lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A vintage maroon coupe occupies the lower two-thirds, angled toward the left, with figures clustered on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The maroon vintage car serves as the central weight, grounding the photographic section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down scanning from the pink header, through the black bar, to the large blue title, finally resting on the beach scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and sand provide breathing room around the dense typographic blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors against a naturalistic, sun-bleached photographic palette.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized slant for the secondary large title to imply motion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacked weights of the same sans-serif family, varying by color and slant.
graphicDevices: Stereo sound logo at top center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed width of the display text.
Provides the necessary slant and weight for the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright, sunny beach scene featuring a vintage 1930s maroon coupe parked on the sand. Include a group of young people in 60s casual wear leaning on the car, with a surfboard visible. The top third of the image should be a solid white area for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top band of magenta condensed sans-serif text. Below it, add a thin black horizontal bar with small orange text. Finally, overlay a large blue italicized sans-serif title across the horizon line.

verificationChecks: Is the top text magenta and uppercase?
Is there a black horizontal bar separating the text blocks?
Is the main title blue and slanted?
Is the car a vintage maroon coupe?

adjustableVariables: Color of the top text band
Number of people in the scene
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not obscure the faces of the people.
Ensure the magenta and blue colors are vibrant and not muddy.
Verify the black bar is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the vintage car is the primary visual anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a sunny outdoor photograph, add a solid color header with bold sans-serif type, and overlay a second, larger slanted title in a contrasting primary color.
